provenance.notes: Formulas from CF sheet, first operating column G (period 1). Scalars from named ranges / fixed cells.

B109.description: Distribution lockup DSCR threshold (sourced from Inputs!D223)

B86.description: Senior DSRA target (Oborovo: 0 — no DSRA required)

CF86.description: Senior DSRA target for this period

CF91.notes: opening + funding + top-up - release. Oborovo: all movements = 0, ending = 0.

CF94.description: Free Cash Flow for Junior Debt (= signed_post_senior in G2C for no-junior-debt)

CF95.description: Junior debt repayment and interest (= 0 for no-junior-debt projects)

CF110.description: Distribution Account closing balance (carry-forward to next period F110)

CF112.description: Free Cash Flow for Shareholder Loan (= gate output, CF112 = CF109)

CF138.description: Base DSCR for gate evaluation (referenced in CF109 gate component A)
